notes.note: Reviewed the protocol 4 unresolved command paragraph against the current inventory descriptor SQL, shared transcript fold, and frozen continuation. Cold reads fold compact pages. A current read can resume only from an exact durable event anchor. The randomized comparisons preserve standing and replaced results, and the WAL control verifies that one outer inventory query keeps its old snapshot across a concurrent writer.

Reviewed the EventStore delta across the cited architecture, migration, persistence, monitoring, configuration, and work-item claims. The change is confined to the read-only Whole Session inventory unresolved-result predicate, which uses compact pages on a cold read and resumes verified cached prefixes. There is no migration or change to writers, worker ownership, monitored event names, authorization, host placement, or durable Monument evidence and work-item storage.

The transcript and Session inventory share the event reducer. Ordinary transcript callers still render full rows and approval detail. The inventory mode retains turn and tool identity only, and carries standing unresolved results across append reads. Tool policy and approval authority rules remain at their existing owners.

The contract adds the internal cold and warm read distinction for the existing protocol 4 unresolved tool row. The row vocabulary, protocol version rules, frozen cursor and ownership boundaries are unchanged, so the linked integration guidance, glossary terms, and package contract instructions still apply.
